domain: Training and evaluating tool-using, evidence-grounded AI research agents
status: Unreviewed development prompts. These may guide training and must never be reported as held-out evaluation results.

questions.retrieval_query: collect references browsing support answers human feedback
questions.question: How does WebGPT combine browsing, reference collection, imitation learning, and human feedback? Which parts of that workflow transfer to a private AI-paper assistant, and which claims require a new experiment?

questions.retrieval_query: unsupported claims attribution revision tool interactive critiquing self correction
questions.question: Compare RARR's research-and-revision process with CRITIC's tool-interactive self-correction. What evidence suggests each could reduce unsupported claims, and what would we need to test on AI papers?

questions.retrieval_query: self supervised tool calls instruction tuning real world APIs
questions.question: How do Toolformer and ToolLLM obtain training data for tool use? Compare their supervision and explain which approach better resembles our structured paper-search trajectories.

questions.retrieval_query: fine grained atomic factual precision citation correctness completeness evaluation
questions.question: Why are factual precision and citation quality separate measurements? Compare FActScore with the citation correctness and completeness evaluation used by ALCE, then propose metrics for our agent.

questions.retrieval_query: iterative retrieval generation search enhanced reasoning long context knowledge
questions.question: Compare Iter-RetGen and Search-o1 as approaches to searches that depend on earlier evidence. What is trained or prompted in each system, and what result would justify adding iterative search to our assistant?

questions.retrieval_query: human evaluated attributed explanations citation quality information seeking
questions.question: What do HAGRID and ALCE contribute to evaluating attributed answers? Identify which annotations or metrics could inform human review of our paper assistant.

questions.retrieval_query: benchmark general assistants interactive environments tool use multi turn agents
questions.question: Compare what AgentBench and GAIA test. Which capabilities overlap with evidence-grounded research, and which important citation-support behavior is outside their reported evaluation?

questions.retrieval_query: fresh changing knowledge false premises search engine evidence order hallucination
questions.question: What does FreshLLMs report about fast-changing knowledge, false premises, evidence quantity, and evidence ordering? Explain what would change when search is limited to a dated private corpus.

questions.retrieval_query: writing articles outline retrieval multi perspective information seeking citations
questions.question: Compare STORM's article-writing workflow with WebGPT's reference-backed question answering. Which design is more relevant to producing an explainable research brief from several papers?

questions.retrieval_query: negative examples agent fine tuning effective agent tuning data methods
questions.question: What do Learning From Failure and Agent-FLAN imply about constructing agent-training data? Separate their reported findings from the hypothesis that those ideas will improve our Qwen research agent.

questions.retrieval_query: multi turn tool use data synthesis distillation graph translation APIs trajectories
questions.question: Compare Magnet's multi-turn tool-use data synthesis with ToolLLM's API-oriented training pipeline. Which design choices are relevant to distilling research trajectories into Qwen?

questions.retrieval_query: deep research reinforcement learning real world search browsing human feedback
questions.question: Compare DeepResearcher's reinforcement-learning setup with WebGPT's imitation and preference-based workflow. What controlled experiment would tell us whether SFT alone is enough for our smaller agent?

questions.retrieval_query: challenging benchmark browsing agents hidden hard questions factual citations
questions.question: What does BrowseComp measure about browsing agents, and why would strong BrowseComp performance still not prove that an AI-paper answer's citations support every claim?

questions.retrieval_query: self challenging agents self generated tasks multi turn tool use synthetic data
questions.question: Compare Self-Challenging's self-generated tasks with Magnet's synthetic multi-turn trajectories. What contamination and quality checks would we need before using either idea?

questions.exclusion_reason: Closely repeats pilot_05's reserved GPU and latency question. Retain only as a historical development diagnostic.
questions.retrieval_query: single 24GB GPU Qwen latency two seconds guarantee deployment
questions.question: Do these papers establish that our exact Qwen3-8B agent will run on one 24GB GPU and finish every research question within two seconds? State what the corpus supports and what must be measured directly.
